definitions.title: Arc Length of a Smooth Curve
definitions.statement: If f' is continuous on [a, b], the length of the curve y = f(x) from x = a to x = b is the integral of the differential arc length ds = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) = sqrt(1 + (f'(x))^2) dx.
conditions: f'(x) is continuous on [a, b] (smooth curve)
definitions.explanation: Derived as the limit of polygonal path lengths approximating the curve.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Arc length integrates the Pythagorean root sqrt(1 + (dy/dx)^2).

definitions.title: Arc Length with Respect to y
definitions.statement: For a smooth curve given as x = g(y) from y = c to y = d, the arc length is integrated with respect to y.
definitions.explanation: Useful when solving for x as a function of y yields a cleaner derivative.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Symmetric formulation with respect to the vertical coordinate.
